name: TCL 50C725K
summary: TCL 50C725K ships with TCL content pushes, Live FAST channels and analytics. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This TCL runs Android TV 11 with 2 GB of memory. It ships with TCL pushing content to the home screen, TCL Live FAST channels, app promos in the TCL menu, a store demo sticker, TCL notifications and TCL analytics. Partner apps install themselves silently, and preloaded browsers, a gallery and a voice assistant use memory too.

The list was applied on a real unit and survived a reboot. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each one can be switched back on. The TCL system apps that run the remote and inputs are kept.
keep: Live TV (the TCL TV app) and the TCL input service
The remote's Bluetooth pairing and system services
The TCL account and the firmware updater
notes: Google voice assistant uses about 175 MB of memory and is off by choice. Switch it back on in the app if you use voice.
Several apps, such as the browser and the screen reader, are off by choice.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 50C725K?
faq.a: Not with the default list, which turns off the Google voice assistant by choice. Switch it back on in the app if you use voice.
